resources.string: Describe the task, reminder time and recurrence. Review what is sent to your chosen model, then edit its proposal. Only the final Save creates a reminder. Unclear times need clarification.
Example: Remind me to drink water tomorrow at 3 pm
Only the description below and the displayed reference time and timezone are sent. Existing reminders, chats and library materials are excluded.
This description, reference time and timezone will be sent to the provider above. Local storage does not mean local inference.
No valid proposal received. No reminder created. Specify an exact time or create it manually.
Drafting interrupted. No reminder created and no automatic retry.
Update the description and draft again:
Model proposal · not saved. Check or edit the title, date, timezone and recurrence. Only Save activates it.
Save was submitted. Check the list for the saved item and scheduling result. Your edits remain available if the operation fails.
